{{Quote|Ahoy yacht! This is Captain Jayhawk of the Rebellion privateer ''Martinette!'' We mean to take your cargo, but will let you and your vessel go free. Heave and drop your shields or we will fire on you!|Captain Jayhawk|<ref name="Godking" />}}
'''Jayhawk''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], commanding the freighter ''[[Martinette]]''. He pretended to be a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a mean to obtain a profit.

==Biography==
Jayhawk was a ruthless [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''[[Martinette]]'', a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] with a crew of eight, including himself. Jayhawk promoted the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] pirate [[Mirthen]] as his second-in-command. Jayhawk commonly pretended to be a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] with a [[Letter of marque/Legends|letter of marque and reprisal]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] when raiding an enemy [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. In this guise, Jayhawk successfully robbed and captured several small [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], stranding their crew in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] or on unsettled [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="Godking" />

Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Tests of the Godking]]" is stated to occur shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which is established to have happened in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|The Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Jayhawk visited the planet [[Abonshee]] and met with [[Godking]] [[Trisstan]] of the native [[Anointed People]]. Jayhawk again pretended to be a member of the Alliance on a diplomatic mission. However, once he had the trust of Trisstan, Jayhawk stole from the [[King/Legends|king's]] treasury and escaped the planet. Soon afterward, Jayhawk and the ''Martinette'' attacked a pleasure yacht, the ''[[Long Shot]]''. At that point, Jayhawk did not know that the ''Long Shot'' was part of the Alliance.<ref name="Godking" />

==Personality and traits==
Jayhawk was a ruthless individual who did not kill people "unnecessarily", but he did abandon the crews of ships he captured without caring if they survived, such as on a backwater planet or in escape pods. Jayhawk promoted Mirthen, a drug-addict pirate, to the position of his second-in-command because Mirthen was unambitious and would not conspire against him, not because of Mirthen's skills. Jayhawk was a thin man who favored black pants, white shirts and red vests. He had a pencil-thin moustache. He commonly carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[saber]], and he knew how to use both.<ref name="Godking" />
